subject: Request: ad-hoc studio credits for cohort demo week
messages:
From: Kate Lin <kate@launchlabs.co>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — ad-hoc studio credits for our demo week

Hi Markus + Laura,

Hope you both are well — we're gearing up for our Demo Week (Aug 30) and usage has spiked unexpectedly while teams iterate on the final builds. We had budgeted for the standard 50k-token pilot, but we'll likely need another ~120k tokens over the next 3 weeks for load testing and live demos.

Would Redwood be able to provide a one-off ad-hoc credit bump (promo/trial) to cover the delta? If possible: 120k token credit, expires 2027-09-15. We can provide a brief post-demo usage summary if you need it.

If there's a short form or PO required on our side, please let me know and I'll loop Accounts Payable. Appreciate any flexibility — this Demo Week has investor and partner attendance, so it's pretty high-impact for us.

Thanks,
Kate Lin
Program Director, LaunchLabs
Kate@launchlabs.co

Attachment: (usage_sample.png)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — ad-hoc studio credits for our demo week

Looping you both in — LaunchLabs asks for ~120k tokens as a one-off bump through Sep 15. They flagged investor/partner audience for Demo Week which increases the ask priority.

Initial thoughts: we can consider a short-term credit grant from the promo pool for partner cohorts. Need finance sign-off if we exceed the usual promotional cap. Laura—can you confirm the promo pool headroom and any precedent for 2.4x over standard pilot? I've attached a quick usage excerpt they sent (launchlabs_usage_report_Q3.csv).

If we greenlight, we should condition on a short post-demo usage report and a mention in our partnership highlight (mutually agreeable language). Also, flagging that if this becomes recurring we should discuss converting to a month-to-month paid plan.

-Markus
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: launchlabs_usage_report_Q3.csv

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — ad-hoc studio credits for our demo week

Thanks for the context. Quick notes:
- Promo pool: we have limited headroom in Q3; ad-hoc grants >100k tokens need VP sign-off unless there's a clear revenue path.
- Precedent: we did a similar bump for NovaForge last year but attached conditions: (a) post-mortem usage report, (b) one marketing mention, (c) PO/confirmation from AP for audit.

Can you / should we ask them for a short ROI note (how Demo Week drives conversion) to justify exceeding the standard cap? Also want to keep the expiration date tight (Sep 15) and require usage tagging so we can attribute conversions.

I'll prep a short memo to attach to the request for Jordan's sign-off.

-Laura
Director, Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-17T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — ad-hoc studio credits for our demo week

Provided the following conditions are met, I'm comfortable approving a one-time 120,000 token credit from the partner promo pool:
1) Expiry fixed to 2027-09-15 (no rollovers).
2) LaunchLabs provides a short post-demo usage & impact note within 10 days of Demo Week.
3) Accounts Payable provides a PO or confirmation email (for our audit trail).

I've completed the internal approval form. Attaching completed approval doc for records.

-Jordan Blake
VP, Strategic Partnerships

Attachment: credit_approval_form.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Kate Lin <kate@launchlabs.co>, accounts-payable@launchlabs.co
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-19T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: 120k demo-week credit (LaunchLabs) — next steps

Hi Kate — good news: we've approved a one-time 120,000 token credit to support LaunchLabs' Demo Week. Summary of terms below (Jordan's approval is quoted for transparency):

--- Forwarded approval ---
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-17T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — ad-hoc studio credits for our demo week

"Provided the following conditions are met, I'm comfortable approving a one-time 120,000 token credit from the partner promo pool: 1) Expiry fixed to 2027-09-15 (no rollovers). 2) LaunchLabs provides a short post-demo usage & impact note within 10 days of Demo Week. 3) Accounts Payable provides a PO or confirmation email (for our audit trail.)"
--- end forwarded approval ---

Our ask from LaunchLabs to activate credit:
- Please confirm acceptance of the terms above.
- Send a PO or a reply from accounts-payable@launchlabs.co confirming the request (simple one-line confirmation is fine).

Once we receive the PO/confirmation we'll apply the 120k token credit to your studio account and send a confirmation email with the credit id and expiry. We'll also share a small attribution tag you can use in requests so we can monitor conversions.

Thanks — excited to support Demo Week. If anything changes (scope or timing) please tell us asap.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai

Attachments: credit_approval_form.pdf (internal), launchlabs_usage_report_Q3.csv (original sample)
